description: This PHP class defines the AWS Organizations client, providing method signatures (doc comments) for interacting with AWS Organizations service, including operations like creating accounts, inviting accounts, listing organizational units, etc. It extends the AwsClient class and is likely part of the AWS SDK for PHP.
